helpline.bannerText: Telangana-Helpline, empowers the caller to get prompt response from the Police response team.
helpline.heading: HELPLINE 112
helpline.subheading: Call us for any emergency support response immediately
helpline.paragraph1: Dial 112 is a nationwide emergency helpline implemented by Government of India designed to provide swift and efficient responses during emergencies. In Telangana this services is available 24*7 ensuring that citizens can easily connect with emergency services like police, fire, and medical assistance all through a single number 112.
helpline.paragraph2: The Telangana Government in collaboration with various services, aims to offer timely help in critical situations, reducing responses times, saving lives and improving the overall safety of its citizen.
